# Review & Rest

Welcome to **Day 7**. Today, we are diving deep into **Review & Rest**.

## 🎯 Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, you will be able to:

1. Understand the core principles behind review & rest.
2. Implement these concepts using the Google Gemini ecosystem.
3. Successfully complete today's hands-on exercise.

## 📖 Core Concepts


::: {.panel-tabset}
## The Power of Iteration
A core tenet of Vibe Coding is that your first draft is rarely your final draft. Because code generation is so fast, the cost of refactoring drops to near zero.

## Reviewing your Architecture
Look at the CLI app you built yesterday. How does it handle API timeouts? What if the user inputs gibberish? 
Today, your goal is to use Gemini to *critique* your own code and generate a more robust, error-handled version.
:::


## 💻 Hands-on Exercise

It's time to put theory into practice! Spend the next 45 minutes on the following challenge:

**Task:** Reflect on Week 1. Refactor your CLI flashcard generator to improve the prompt, add robust error handling, and support scoring.

**Requirements:**

- Use the Gemini SDK or AI Studio.
- Ensure the output is well-formatted and handles errors gracefully.
- Test it with at least two different edge cases.

## ✅ Wrap-up

Today we covered Review & Rest. Tomorrow, we will build upon this by exploring **the next week’s topics**.
